race.comment: SANDASTAN (1) is an in-form stayer with three wins from his last four, two of them at his grade although over shorter trips. Came from worse than midfield on the bend last start to easily put away his rivals over 2050m at Strathalbyn. Has two wins and two placings from five runs at this distance. Can win again although 62kgs is a concern. HARLEY'N'ROSE (3) has raced exclusively in Saturday company of late, the best effort coming two back when a closing third over 2500m at Murray Bridge. Not a prolific winner but must be respected in this company. GIRLS GIRLS GIRLS (6) charged home to win two back over 2121m at Gawler two back then was found out in Saturday grade last time. Has won here at the distance and can bounce back. OCTAHEDRON (4) is a dour stayer who was in the money two runs ago over 3150m at Mt Gambier in a BM75. Will roll forward and keep grinding away. The form of TEE EIGHT (9) has been patchy but his did fill a minor placing at his only attempt over today's trip.
